title: Diary Of A Butterfly
desc: Gul, an aspiring model, wants to make it big in the fashion industry and decides to leave no stone unless turned to achieve success. However, she soon realises that success comes at a price

title: Baabul
desc: After the death of her husband, a woman decides to live the rest of her life as a widow and take care of her young son. She is surprised when her in-laws advise her to remarry and move on with her life.

title: Karobaar : The Business Of Love
desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.
